Found the bug — the prune check compares residual capacity to *static* demand instead of *remaining* demand. Fix:

The search is nearly deterministic (1 candidate/node) and needs walk diversity too. Let me add noise-perturbed walk variants:
The filters starve the search — I need *constraint-aware* tree generation. Let me implement a Prim variant that respects the gateway constraints while building:
